supported_claims: A Berlin directory published in 1918 lists a unit named 2. Garderegiment zu Fuß.
The listed unit has Berlin barracks, including Friedrichstraße 107 for the first and second battalions.
The period title and city are consistent with the candidate 2 GARDEREGT and BERLIN fragments of p89 A3.
The page treats Kaiser Franz Garde-Gren.Rgt. Nr. 2 as a separate unit.
scope_limits: The entry does not separately identify the Ersatzbataillon of the 2. Garderegiment zu Fuß.
An annual directory listing does not establish this depot’s location or orders on the exact November transmission date.
The entry prints the full unit title; it does not independently attest the proposed genitive abbreviation GARDEREGTS or the cipher spelling Z FUSZ.
No wholly absent letter, numeral, separator, street address, or received-coordinate repair is inferred from the directory.
The directory is contextual corroboration, not an additional native cryptanalytic witness.
